trn.r01: EK51 alerted: small fire south of Narrow Lake, reported size about 0.2 ha.
trn.r02: EK52: road R6 is passable north from the junction, no obstacles.
trn.r03: EK51: we are on scene. A small fire in heath forest south of road R5, estimated about 0.4 ha, flames under a metre.
trn.r04: DR8 sensor log at 10.00: altitude 120 m, battery 82 %.
trn.r05: EK51: hose laid along the fire's south-west edge, two men on the line, water is enough.
trn.r06: DR8 thermal image at 10.05: burning area about 1.1 ha, the head advancing north-east, speed about 10 m/min. (reliability good.)
trn.r07: EK51 status when asked: tank water about 85 %, crew of four, fuel is enough.
trn.r08: DR8: the fire's head is at road R5 now.
trn.r09: EK52: road R6 is blocked about 300 m north of the junction, a vehicle across the road. Returning to the junction.
trn.r10: EK52 status when asked: tank water about 60 %, crew of three.
trn.r11: EK51: the pump is running, 150 m of hose.
trn.r12: EK51 shift log: the shift began at 09.58.
